description: This source file defines the MarkdownBodyPartDisplayDriver class, which manages the display, editing, and updating of MarkdownBodyPart content within OrchardCore CMS. It handles rendering Markdown to HTML, applying Liquid templates, processing shortcodes, and sanitizing HTML based on settings.

classes.name: MarkdownBodyPartDisplayDriver
classes.description: A driver class responsible for rendering, editing, and updating MarkdownBodyPart content, including Markdown to HTML conversion, Liquid rendering, shortcode processing, and HTML sanitization.

methods.name: Display
methods.description: Returns the display shape for the MarkdownBodyPart, positioning it in Detail and Summary locations.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Returns the editor shape for the MarkdownBodyPart, initializing the view model with current content.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Handles the update process for the MarkdownBodyPart, validating Liquid syntax and updating the model.

methods.name: BuildViewModel
methods.description: Builds the view model for display, converting Markdown to HTML, rendering Liquid templates, processing shortcodes, and sanitizing HTML based on settings.
